newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 14.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section:
WASHINGTON - PSINet Inc.'s shares fell 18 percent after the Internet service provider said its fourth-quarter sales would be significantly lower than many projections.
WASHINGTON - The Securities and Exchange Commission released a "plain English" handbook to get corporations to write clearer annual reports.
WASHINGTON - The organisation representing U.S. business in Japan issued a downbeat appraisal of Washington's efforts to open the Japanese market over the past 16 years.
WASHINGTON - A new study found that clubs, colleges and class standing made a difference in determining the salary paid to chief executive officers of companies.
